methods: Choose Toxic Bullets if you can maintain weapon hits, or Decay for targeted healing reduction. Apply it before the sustain window.

Both combine percentage-health damage with anti-heal. They are situational against healing items or upgraded Granny Long Legs melee lifesteal; anti-heal does not counter the barrier from Soothing Brew.

best.note: She keeps stabilizing at low health
methods: Apply Decay before the finish attempt.
Strong healing reduction plus current-health damage attacks the exact sustain window she relies on to survive while low.

best.note: He keeps healing through every attempt to finish him
methods: Apply Decay or another reliably applied anti-heal source before committing your team’s damage.
Keep healing reduction and focused damage active together; denying the next sustain cast can help finish Victor.

alts.text: Healbane turns your spirit damage into healing reduction, making it a natural counter-buy for ability users facing sustain. Apply it before the enemy gets full value from healing, then use the reduced recovery to help your team secure the kill.

Toxic Bullets gives weapon users anti-heal and percentage-health bleed after repeated shooting. It fits carries who can keep landing shots on a sustain target, with the application built before the enemy's important healing window.

Spirit Burn rewards builds that can reach its spirit-damage trigger, adding an explosion, damage over time, and healing reduction. It combines damage scaling with anti-sustain pressure, but you must trigger the effect before the enemy's recovery decides the fight.

auto-cleanse.name: Непреклонность
auto-cleanse.short: Automatically breaks the next qualifying control effect and grants a barrier.
auto-cleanse.intro: Unexpected single-event control setups, such as Haze's Sleep Dagger follow-up.
auto-cleanse.who: Players facing a sudden hard-control event that is difficult to answer manually.
auto-cleanse.when: Keep its automatic protection available for the important catch. Use the barrier and freed action window to escape or respond before the rest of the sequence arrives.
auto-cleanse.example: Against Bebop: Use Indomitable for the first hard-control event or Unstoppable proactively. Breaking the hook control prevents the bomb and uppercut follow-up from becoming a full combo.
auto-cleanse.watch: The item answers the next qualifying control event. Repeated control can exhaust its protection, and it does not guarantee an escape from every combo or protected channel.
auto-cleanse.buy: Consider it when sudden hard control repeatedly starts a lethal follow-up and manual reactions are unreliable. Check which effect will trigger it: a lesser catch can spend the protection before the decisive engage.
why: Automatic combo-breaker against a single hard-control event
Best when the dangerous control is difficult to react to manually

best.note: The hook combo keeps deciding fights
methods: Use Indomitable for the first hard-control event or Unstoppable proactively.
Breaking the hook control prevents the bomb and uppercut follow-up from becoming a full combo.

best.note: Haze Sleep Dagger into burst keeps killing you from stealth
methods: Use Indomitable as the passive combo breaker.
Haze can start the sequence unexpectedly, so an automatic answer is more reliable than a reaction-only defensive item.

best.note: Holliday Lasso keeps kidnapping you out of position
methods: Use Indomitable if you cannot reliably react, or Counterspell/Unstoppable if you can.
Lasso is the fight-defining control and must be denied before the displacement converts into a kill.

best.note: Their ultimate grab is isolating you for a kill
methods: Use Indomitable or Unstoppable; Counterspell is possible but harder to time.
The grab is the fight-ending event, so a dedicated hard-control answer is worth the slot.

best.note: Paradoxical Swap keeps catching you before you can use Warp Stone
methods: Use Indomitable when you need an automatic answer to the swap control.
The ultimate is the hard-control event that consumes the proc, giving you protection when reaction-based repositioning is not reliable enough.

best.note: Her fast hard-control setup is catching you before you can react
methods: Use Indomitable for the automatic hard-control cleanse.
The stun can be too fast for consistent proactive Unstoppable timing, but Indomitable must be triggered by the control itself.

alts.text: Unstoppable protects a planned commitment from crowd control. Activate it before the dangerous control sequence begins, especially when repeated disables would stop you from completing an engage or dealing damage. You still need a position that survives the incoming damage.

Reactive Barrier adds an automatic shield after a hard-control catch. It helps absorb the follow-up damage that often turns a stun into a kill, giving you a chance to reach cover or receive help once you can act again.

Counterspell rewards reading an enemy's commitment. By upgrading your parry to block ability damage and effects during its protection window, it lets you turn a predictable burst or control attempt into a missed opportunity for the opponent.

superior-stamina.name: Превосходная выносливость
superior-stamina.short: Improves stamina for repeated dodges and escapes.
superior-stamina.intro: Control and chase patterns that reward repeated movement or vertical avoidance.
superior-stamina.who: Players whose matchup demands repeated dashes or vertical movement while preserving an escape.
superior-stamina.when: Preserve stamina for the next control pattern instead of spending every movement option on your approach, especially against Dynamo or Sinclair.
superior-stamina.example: Against Dynamo: Use extra stamina and vertical movement to jump the knockup pattern. The pulse is ground-oriented, so staying above its timing can deny repeated setup value.
superior-stamina.watch: Additional mobility still needs deliberate resource use. It cannot help an escape if all available movement is spent before the catch.
superior-stamina.buy: Upgrade when basic stamina no longer covers the repeated movement your fights require. Buy for a clear pattern of dodges or escapes, and keep enough capacity for the enemy's decisive ability.

best.note: Repeated Kinetic Pulse knockups are setting up his damage
methods: Use extra stamina and vertical movement to jump the knockup pattern.
The pulse is ground-oriented, so staying above its timing can deny repeated setup value.

alts.text: Extra Stamina gives you more movement decisions in a fight. An additional dash or air movement option can be the difference between dodging a readable threat and having nothing left after spending stamina to farm or trade.

Fleetfoot helps you manage fighting distance with an active speed boost. It suits heroes who want to keep pressure on a target while kiting away from close-range threats, or quickly change position before the next damaging exchange.

Warp Stone gives you an immediate position change and bullet resistance, helping escape a close threat or committed damage angle. Pick a destination that removes follow-up pressure; teleporting within the same danger wastes much of the opportunity.

debuff-reducer.name: Уменьшитель эффектов
debuff-reducer.short: Shortens status effects without needing an active button.
debuff-reducer.intro: Repeated debuff and control pressure that matters through several exchanges.
debuff-reducer.who: Players who face repeated status effects and want a passive reduction to the time they lose.
debuff-reducer.when: Consider it when many smaller debuff windows are disrupting trades or movement. Use the shorter window to resume pressure or reach a safer position.
debuff-reducer.example: Against Infernus: Add Debuff Reducer when the burn is being reapplied constantly. Shorter debuff duration reduces the value of repeated Afterburn procs between Dispel Magic cooldowns and makes resets much easier.
debuff-reducer.watch: Shorter duration is not the same as removing the effect immediately or becoming immune. A decisive catch can still need a dedicated answer.
debuff-reducer.buy: Consider it when repeated status effects disrupt several exchanges. If one particular catch is instantly lethal, prioritize a tool that directly answers that catch instead of only shortening its duration.
why: Useful when a shorter control or debuff window lets you survive and respond

best.note: Infernus keeps reapplying Afterburn faster than Dispel Magic is available
methods: Add Debuff Reducer when the burn is being reapplied constantly.
Shorter debuff duration reduces the value of repeated Afterburn procs between Dispel Magic cooldowns and makes resets much easier.

best.note: Combo is locking you down for too long
methods: Buy Debuff Reducer if Combo duration is the main problem.
It is a cheap way to shorten the long control window without committing immediately to a high-tier active.

alts.text: Dispel Magic resets a fight weighed down by removable non-ultimate debuffs. Use it to clear effects such as Bebop's Sticky Bomb before detonation, then reposition or recommit with the debuff gone. Its activation restrictions are part of the decision.

Unstoppable protects a planned commitment from crowd control. Activate it before the dangerous control sequence begins, especially when repeated disables would stop you from completing an engage or dealing damage. You still need a position that survives the incoming damage.

Spellbreaker helps against spirit-heavy burst through spirit and debuff resistance plus periodic mitigation of a large spirit hit. Its protection is most valuable when available for the ability that matters, rather than spent on an earlier qualifying hit.

magic-shock.name: Гроза танков
magic-shock.short: Percentage current-health damage that bypasses spirit resistance.
magic-shock.intro: High-health frontliners such as Rat King and Abrams.
magic-shock.who: Damage builds that need their pressure to remain useful into a large enemy health pool.
magic-shock.when: Choose it when high health is the reason a target takes too long to finish, then use a coordinated damage window rather than an unsupported chase.
magic-shock.watch: High-health damage does not by itself stop healing or remove defensive casts. Add the relevant sustain or control answer when that is also extending the fight.
magic-shock.buy: Consider it when raw health is the reason your target takes too long to finish. Confirm whether the real obstacle is health, healing, or a defensive cooldown before choosing the purchase.

alts.text: Siphon Bullets creates a temporary health swing through repeated weapon hits, stealing a percentage of the enemy's maximum health. Against a large-health target, sustained contact and a coordinated finish help convert that temporary advantage before the stolen health returns.

Scourge pairs defensive resistance with a close-range aura that damages enemies based on maximum health. It suits heroes who can stay near a large-health target without losing the fight simply to maintain aura uptime.

Toxic Bullets gives weapon users anti-heal and percentage-health bleed after repeated shooting. It fits carries who can keep landing shots on a sustain target, with the application built before the enemy's important healing window.

pool-of-restoration.name: Живительный медальон
pool-of-restoration.short: Consumes accumulated stacks for a self-heal.
pool-of-restoration.intro: Lane poke and repeated health attrition that can be reset between fights.
pool-of-restoration.who: Players who need a health reset and can use the item's accumulated stacks to sustain lane presence.
pool-of-restoration.when: Use the recovery to stabilize between damaging exchanges, then change the angle that caused the health loss.
pool-of-restoration.watch: Healing back damage is not prevention of the next burst. Repeated lethal catches may require a direct defensive purchase first.
pool-of-restoration.buy: Consider it when recoverable chip damage keeps forcing you out of lane or skirmishes. If every catch is lethal before you can heal, spend on immediate survival first.

alts.text: Extra Regen is a lane-stabilizing purchase for health lost between trades. The value comes from staying available to last-hit and contest souls: recover behind cover, adjust your angle, and avoid giving back the same health to free poke.

Healing Rite helps you recover between fights and return to lane with enough health to contest farm. It works best when you can step out of the enemy's pressure, complete the recovery safely, and avoid returning to the same exposed angle.

Reactive Barrier adds an automatic shield after a hard-control catch. It helps absorb the follow-up damage that often turns a stun into a kill, giving you a chance to reach cover or receive help once you can act again.

withering-whip.name: Ржавый ствол
withering-whip.short: Reduces enemy fire rate for more manageable gun trades.
withering-whip.intro: Gun-heavy lane pressure and sustained weapon trades.
withering-whip.who: Players needing an early response to a lane opponent's repeated weapon pressure.
withering-whip.when: Apply the fire-rate reduction during the gun exchange, then take a safer trade or create room to clear the lane.
withering-whip.example: Against Grey Talon: Use Rusted Barrel during the weapon-heavy early phase. Early Grey Talon gets substantial pressure from firing safely in the air, so reducing fire rate and bullet resistance helps you contest him.
withering-whip.watch: It addresses weapon attack speed. If ability burst or a catch becomes the main problem, the purchase may need another answer alongside it.
withering-whip.buy: Buy it when an opponent's repeated gunfire is winning lane trades and you need a focused response. Reassess if that opponent shifts toward ability burst or a control combo.

best.note: His early flight pressure is taking over the lane
methods: Use Rusted Barrel during the weapon-heavy early phase.
Early Grey Talon gets substantial pressure from firing safely in the air, so reducing fire rate and bullet resistance helps you contest him.

best.note: Venator fire rate is taking over lane before you can afford Metal Skin
methods: Buy Rusted Barrel as the cheaper lane stabilizer.
Fire-rate reduction lowers the pressure immediately and can buy enough time to reach the stronger gun counters later.

best.note: Wraith fire rate and card pressure are taking over the lane early
methods: Buy Rusted Barrel as an early pressure answer.
Slowing her fire rate reduces how quickly she builds weapon and card value and can stabilize the lane before you need a more expensive bullet-defense item.

alts.text: Suppressor lets spirit-damage users reduce an enemy's fire rate through their damage pressure. It is useful when your spirit damage can reach a gun carry consistently, helping your team trade with less sustained weapon pressure.

Juggernaut slows enemy fire rate when you take hits, helping frontline players manage sustained weapon pressure. It is most useful when you can survive the exchange and keep holding space, rather than absorbing damage from an unwinnable position.

Plated Armor offers passive chances to deflect bullets and prevent weapon on-hit effects. Against repeated gun hits and stacking pressure, it can slow the buildup that makes the exchange dangerous, while leaving you free to manage positioning and other actives.

curse.name: Проклятая реликвия
curse.short: Locks enemy actions and strips non-ultimate buffs, but lowers your damage.
curse.intro: Ability-reliant or slippery targets whose next cast, weapon window, or non-ultimate buff is keeping them safe.
curse.who: Supports and utility players coordinating a team commitment, or another hero willing to accept the outgoing-damage penalty to deny a key target’s tools.
curse.when: Use it before the escape, defensive cast, or vulnerable channel has converted the fight. Let teammates use the short control window, especially when stripping a non-ultimate buff.
curse.example: Against Calico: Use Cursed Relic when your team is ready to burst. The silence and item lock create the short coordinated window Calico normally denies with mobility and defensive cooldowns.
curse.watch: The item reduces your own outgoing damage. Coordinate allied follow-up, wait for a punishable position, and do not assume it removes ultimate buffs.
curse.buy: Buy it when an enemy's escape, defensive items, or non-ultimate buffs keep denying your team's finish. Agree on the follow-up first, especially if you would be sacrificing an important carry damage slot.
why: Creates a short window where slippery or ability-reliant heroes cannot use their normal escape tools
Can strip important non-ultimate buffs before your team commits

best.note: Calico always gets her escape or defensive cooldown off before dying
methods: Use Cursed Relic when your team is ready to burst.
The silence and item lock create the short coordinated window Calico normally denies with mobility and defensive cooldowns.

best.note: Mina only needs one short window to escape every focus attempt
methods: Use Cursed Relic when the team is ready to commit burst.
Silence plus item lock removes the emergency tools that normally let Mina survive the first movement lock and reset the fight.

best.note: Plot Armor barrier is letting her trade without risk
methods: Use Cursed Relic when the barrier/buff is the reason she survives.
Cursed Relic removes non-ultimate buffs and barriers while also silencing her follow-up.

best.note: Rat King Rule, Ratannia! is deciding every teamfight
methods: Interrupt the charge with Cursed Relic before the banner lands; if it is already active, disengage from the aura.
The banner grants allies damage reduction and slow immunity, so continuing the fight inside its radius heavily favors Rat King's team.

best.note: Infuser or the post-ultimate window is letting him survive
methods: Use Cursed Relic as the defensive window ends or to strip a removable buff.
Silencing, disarming, and disabling items creates the short finish window you need before he stabilizes again.

best.note: Cube keeps saving a target you are about to kill
methods: Use Cursed Relic on the buffed target.
Cube is a removable non-ultimate buff, and stripping it can reopen the kill window immediately.

alts.text: Silence Wave creates a cast-denial window before an enemy uses an important ability. Land the projectile as your team is ready to commit, then punish while escape or defensive casts are restricted. A silence is not a universal answer to an already-running channel.

Disarming Hex stops a target from firing their weapon, creating breathing room against gun-focused carries. It is particularly useful when your team wants to keep fighting through the enemy's damage window rather than only protect one player.

Slowing Hex is a targeted answer to movement-dependent escapes. Use the slow and movement-skill silence before the relevant escape begins, with allies already in range to punish; a catch has little value if no one can finish the target.

extra-stamina.name: Добавочная выносливость
extra-stamina.short: Adds movement capacity for another dodge or escape.
extra-stamina.intro: Telegraphed abilities and chases you can avoid with an available dash or vertical move.
extra-stamina.who: Players who need an extra dodge or escape after using movement to trade, engage, or farm.
extra-stamina.when: Preserve part of the extra capacity for the enemy's readable control or damage commitment. More stamina is useful when it leaves you a second movement decision.
extra-stamina.example: Against Warden: Buy Extra Stamina and preserve at least one escape charge. Warden's cage becomes much more dangerous after your stamina is reduced, so increasing the pool gives you more room for the dash-slide and heavy-melee escape.
extra-stamina.watch: Spending all of the added capacity before the threat arrives recreates the same escape problem. Resource management still matters.
extra-stamina.buy: Buy it when you regularly run out of movement before the enemy's important ability arrives. Preserve the added capacity for that threat rather than spending it all on your approach.
why: More room to dodge telegraphed abilities
Helps preserve an escape after trading or engaging

best.note: Warden Alchemical Flask is draining stamina before Binding Word
methods: Buy Extra Stamina and preserve at least one escape charge.
Warden's cage becomes much more dangerous after your stamina is reduced, so increasing the pool gives you more room for the dash-slide and heavy-melee escape.

alts.text: Stamina Mastery supports matchups that demand repeated movement, including successive dodges and vertical escapes. The extra flexibility helps only if you keep a reserve for the next threat instead of spending every movement option on the first exchange.

Enduring Speed helps you reclaim distance against slows and persistent chases. The speed and slow resistance matter most when they let you leave an enemy's preferred range, break an exposed angle, or arrive at cover before another trade.

Warp Stone gives you an immediate position change and bullet resistance, helping escape a close threat or committed damage angle. Pick a destination that removes follow-up pressure; teleporting within the same danger wastes much of the opportunity.

suppressor.name: Подавитель
suppressor.short: Spirit damage reduces enemy fire rate.
suppressor.intro: Weapon carries that your ability damage can consistently reach.
suppressor.who: Heroes who can reliably apply spirit damage and want to reduce a carry’s sustained weapon pressure.
suppressor.when: Apply it while your team is trading into the affected carry. Area spirit damage can reduce the fire rate of several enemies you hit.
suppressor.watch: Its application depends on spirit damage reaching the target. It does not slow movement, disarm the target, remove a debuff on you, or stop ability and melee damage.
suppressor.buy: Buy it when weapon-heavy enemies are winning trades and your abilities can reliably apply the effect. Consider it before the next sustained fight rather than relying on it against damage that already landed.

best.note: I need to disrupt her Threadsap-empowered shooting
methods: Use Disarming Hex during her gun commitment, or Suppressor if you can consistently deal spirit damage to her.
Disarming Hex stops weapon fire, denying shots that would carry Threadsap’s bonus spirit damage. Suppressor reduces fire rate through spirit damage. Neither stops her abilities or melee attacks.

alts.text: Rusted Barrel reduces an enemy's fire rate, making sustained gun trades easier to manage. Apply it during the exchange you want to change, then use the reduced weapon pressure to contest the wave, reposition, or return damage.

Juggernaut slows enemy fire rate when you take hits, helping frontline players manage sustained weapon pressure. It is most useful when you can survive the exchange and keep holding space, rather than absorbing damage from an unwinnable position.

Mystic Slow adds movement pressure to ability damage, helping spirit builds keep enemies within reach or create distance from a pursuer. It works through the damage you can actually land, so reliable ability contact matters more than simply owning the item.

toxic-bullets.name: Токсичные пули
toxic-bullets.short: Repeated weapon hits apply anti-heal and maximum-health bleed.
toxic-bullets.intro: Healing-dependent tanks and sustain targets that remain in weapon range.
toxic-bullets.who: Weapon carries that can maintain repeated hits on the target whose healing matters.
toxic-bullets.when: Build the application before the important healing exchange and keep weapon contact while the team commits.
toxic-bullets.example: Against Abrams: Apply Toxic Bullets or another anti-heal source before committing. Percent max-health bleed plus healing reduction attacks both his large health pool and his sustain.
toxic-bullets.watch: Repeated shooting is part of the application. If you cannot keep landing hits, a direct active or a spirit-triggered anti-heal option may fit your damage pattern better.
toxic-bullets.buy: Buy it when you have reliable weapon uptime and enemy healing keeps undoing your damage. If you cannot maintain hits on the target, compare an anti-heal option that fits your actual damage pattern.

best.note: Her health and sustain build keeps surviving our damage
methods: Choose Toxic Bullets if you can maintain weapon hits, or Decay for targeted healing reduction. Apply it before the sustain window.

Both combine percentage-health damage with anti-heal. They are situational against healing items or upgraded Granny Long Legs melee lifesteal; anti-heal does not counter the barrier from Soothing Brew.

best.note: Abrams healing and high HP are winning long fights
methods: Apply Toxic Bullets or another anti-heal source before committing.
Percent max-health bleed plus healing reduction attacks both his large health pool and his sustain.

best.note: Their huge health pool and sustain are taking too long to burn
methods: Use Toxic Bullets or Decay.
Percentage-health damage and healing reduction both scale well into Mo & Krill's large health pool.

alts.text: Healbane turns your spirit damage into healing reduction, making it a natural counter-buy for ability users facing sustain. Apply it before the enemy gets full value from healing, then use the reduced recovery to help your team secure the kill.

Decay gives you a direct way to put healing reduction on a sustain target, alongside current-health damage over time. It suits fights where you need anti-heal applied deliberately before the enemy starts winning the health trade.

Spirit Burn rewards builds that can reach its spirit-damage trigger, adding an explosion, damage over time, and healing reduction. It combines damage scaling with anti-sustain pressure, but you must trigger the effect before the enemy's recovery decides the fight.

fleetfoot.name: Проворная поступь
fleetfoot.short: Active speed boost for kiting and repositioning.
fleetfoot.intro: Chase and spacing problems that can be improved by kiting.
fleetfoot.who: Players who benefit from kiting and need room to move while keeping pressure on a target.
fleetfoot.when: Use the mobility to maintain a useful fighting distance or move out of the opponent's preferred range before taking the next trade.
fleetfoot.watch: Movement helps only when it changes the angle or distance. It does not replace a cleanse or a protection window after an unavoidable catch.
fleetfoot.buy: Consider it when keeping the right distance would let your build deal damage safely. Buy for a repeatable kiting problem; a movement active has less value if the real issue is a debuff or hard-control catch.

alts.text: Enduring Speed helps you reclaim distance against slows and persistent chases. The speed and slow resistance matter most when they let you leave an enemy's preferred range, break an exposed angle, or arrive at cover before another trade.

Extra Stamina gives you more movement decisions in a fight. An additional dash or air movement option can be the difference between dodging a readable threat and having nothing left after spending stamina to farm or trade.

Warp Stone gives you an immediate position change and bullet resistance, helping escape a close threat or committed damage angle. Pick a destination that removes follow-up pressure; teleporting within the same danger wastes much of the opportunity.

warp-stone.name: Камень переноса
warp-stone.short: Teleports you forward and grants bullet resistance.
warp-stone.intro: Close-range commitments and geometry traps where repositioning changes the exchange.
warp-stone.who: Players needing an immediate change of position against a close threat, wall, or committed ultimate angle.
warp-stone.when: Keep the teleport for the decisive position change. Choose a destination that removes the enemy's follow-up rather than simply moving a short distance inside the same danger.
warp-stone.example: Against Abrams: Hold Warp Stone or use vertical movement for the engage. Repositioning avoids the control entirely instead of relying on Indomitable, which can be consumed by the first stage of Shoulder Charge.
warp-stone.watch: An escape is only as useful as its destination. It does not cleanse a debuff that follows you or replace an answer to every control state.
warp-stone.buy: Buy it when one decisive reposition would let you survive or keep dealing damage. It fits repeated problems with close-range pressure, walls, or ultimate angles better than effects that need a cleanse.

best.note: Shoulder Charge or Seismic Impact keeps catching you
methods: Hold Warp Stone or use vertical movement for the engage.
Repositioning avoids the control entirely instead of relying on Indomitable, which can be consumed by the first stage of Shoulder Charge.

best.note: Paradoxical Swap is pulling you into a losing position
methods: Warp Stone immediately after the swap, or use Indomitable for the ultimate control.
The key is repairing your position before her team gets the free follow-up.

best.note: Her dash keeps sticking to you and extending the chase
methods: Warp over or away from the dash path.
Silver's dash stops when it collides with a player, so moving over it can make her fly past instead of connecting.

best.note: Luggage Cart keeps carrying you into a losing position
methods: Use Warp Stone or vertical movement once the displacement sequence begins.
Repositioning breaks the grounded setup and helps you avoid the follow-up outside his portal.

best.note: Wall or trap setups keep forcing you into bad positions
methods: Reposition with Warp Stone before the follow-up.
Escaping the geometry denies the setup that turns his close-range gun pressure into a kill.

alts.text: Extra Stamina gives you more movement decisions in a fight. An additional dash or air movement option can be the difference between dodging a readable threat and having nothing left after spending stamina to farm or trade.

Ethereal Shift lets you sit out a dangerous moment through brief invulnerability and untargetability. Against a committed burst or a short ultimate window, the goal is to waste the enemy's investment and return with a plan for your next position.

Unstoppable protects a planned commitment from crowd control. Activate it before the dangerous control sequence begins, especially when repeated disables would stop you from completing an engage or dealing damage. You still need a position that survives the incoming damage.

cardio-calibrator.name: Скоростная стойкость
cardio-calibrator.short: Adds speed and slow resistance for easier repositioning.
cardio-calibrator.intro: Persistent slow pressure, including Kelvin's beam and chase.
cardio-calibrator.who: Players losing room to reposition because slows keep extending the enemy's preferred trade.
cardio-calibrator.when: Use the mobility and slow resistance to break the beam or chase angle and reach cover. Reposition before the next exchange rather than continuing it in the same spot.
cardio-calibrator.example: Against Kelvin: Use slow resistance and movement to reach cover or break the beam angle. Keep a separate answer ready if hard control, rather than slowing, is the problem.
cardio-calibrator.watch: Slow resistance does not remove every control effect or disable the pursuer. A catch or repeated engage may need another answer.
cardio-calibrator.buy: Buy it when slows keep turning manageable poke into extended damage, or rotations leave you vulnerable to a chase. It fits best when better movement solves the problem before hard control lands.

best.note: Beam slows keep extending the chase
methods: Use slow resistance and movement to reach cover or break the beam angle. Keep a separate answer ready if hard control, rather than slowing, is the problem.

alts.text: Extra Stamina gives you more movement decisions in a fight. An additional dash or air movement option can be the difference between dodging a readable threat and having nothing left after spending stamina to farm or trade.

Fleetfoot helps you manage fighting distance with an active speed boost. It suits heroes who want to keep pressure on a target while kiting away from close-range threats, or quickly change position before the next damaging exchange.

Warp Stone gives you an immediate position change and bullet resistance, helping escape a close threat or committed damage angle. Pick a destination that removes follow-up pressure; teleporting within the same danger wastes much of the opportunity.

guardian-aura.name: Спасательный луч
guardian-aura.short: Heals a teammate and pulls them out of danger.
guardian-aura.intro: Ally catches such as Holliday's lasso, Mo & Krill's Combo, and Dynamo's protected ultimate pressure.
guardian-aura.who: Players protecting a teammate who is caught in an enemy commitment and needs a new position.
guardian-aura.when: Keep a view of the ally and a useful pull destination. Use the save to remove them from the ongoing angle rather than only restoring health in the same danger.
guardian-aura.example: Against Dynamo: Use Rescue Beam on a trapped teammate from outside the ultimate. Once the channel cannot be interrupted, pulling an ally out becomes one of the few remaining ways to save them.
guardian-aura.watch: The resulting position matters. Plan where the ally will land and how the team handles the next attempt to catch them.
guardian-aura.buy: Buy it when allies repeatedly get caught in positions you can pull them out of. Choose it before important team fights and make sure your own position offers a safer destination.

best.note: Dynamo is protecting Singularity with Unstoppable
methods: Use Rescue Beam on a trapped teammate from outside the ultimate.
Once the channel cannot be interrupted, pulling an ally out becomes one of the few remaining ways to save them.

best.note: Holliday Lasso keeps kidnapping your teammate
methods: Rescue Beam the kidnapped teammate as soon as the displacement creates danger.
Pulling the ally back to your position can undo the pick even when the victim did not have their own Counterspell or Unstoppable ready.

best.note: Mo & Krill Combo has grabbed a teammate you need to save
methods: Use Rescue Beam on the grabbed ally when positioning allows.
Team-save utility can deny the isolation kill even when the victim did not have Indomitable or Unstoppable available.

alts.text: Divine Barrier turns a defensive purchase into a teammate save. Its shield and debuff purge can protect an ally during a dangerous sequence, including removable bomb pressure, when you keep a clear view and a usable save angle.

Unstoppable protects a planned commitment from crowd control. Activate it before the dangerous control sequence begins, especially when repeated disables would stop you from completing an engage or dealing damage. You still need a position that survives the incoming damage.

Warp Stone gives you an immediate position change and bullet resistance, helping escape a close threat or committed damage angle. Pick a destination that removes follow-up pressure; teleporting within the same danger wastes much of the opportunity.

spirit-burn.name: Спиритический ожог
spirit-burn.short: Spirit-damage buildup triggers an explosion, burn, and healing reduction.
spirit-burn.intro: Healing-dependent opponents reached by your spirit damage.
spirit-burn.who: Spirit-damage builds that can reliably keep healing reduction on a sustain target.
spirit-burn.when: Apply your spirit damage before the enemy's healing window decides the exchange. Continue with a fight plan that uses the reduction to finish or force a retreat.
spirit-burn.example: Against Graves: Apply strong anti-heal before the all-in. Graves has meaningful sustain, and cutting the recovery window makes her much easier to finish once her summons are cleared.
spirit-burn.watch: You must reach Spirit Burn’s spirit-damage trigger to apply its healing reduction. Against Victor, coordinate your damage and cast denial so the anti-heal is active during the finish.
spirit-burn.buy: Buy it when your spirit build can reliably trigger the burn and you need damage alongside anti-heal. If sustain needs an immediate answer before that investment, compare Healbane or Decay.
why: Fits spirit builds that can reliably trigger and maintain the burn

best.note: She keeps healing through your pressure
methods: Apply strong anti-heal before the all-in.
Graves has meaningful sustain, and cutting the recovery window makes her much easier to finish once her summons are cleared.

best.note: His healing is making every extended fight unwinnable
methods: Apply anti-heal before committing inside or around the dome.
Kelvin gains large value from sustain, so cutting healing turns the fight from a stall into a realistic kill window.

alts.text: Healbane turns your spirit damage into healing reduction, making it a natural counter-buy for ability users facing sustain. Apply it before the enemy gets full value from healing, then use the reduced recovery to help your team secure the kill.

Decay gives you a direct way to put healing reduction on a sustain target, alongside current-health damage over time. It suits fights where you need anti-heal applied deliberately before the enemy starts winning the health trade.

Toxic Bullets gives weapon users anti-heal and percentage-health bleed after repeated shooting. It fits carries who can keep landing shots on a sustain target, with the application built before the enemy's important healing window.

monster-rounds.name: Чудовищные патроны
monster-rounds.short: Improves damage against minions and summons.
monster-rounds.intro: Minion and summon pressure from Graves, McGinnis, and Rem.
monster-rounds.who: Players who need better minion and summon clear to preserve farm or dismantle an enemy position.
monster-rounds.when: Clear resources before a direct hero fight whenever safe. Use the purchase to reduce the pressure from turrets, helpers, or summon waves instead of fighting through all of them.
monster-rounds.example: Against Graves: Buy Monster Rounds as the cheaper early answer. Extra damage into NPCs and summons helps you clear her spawned pressure sooner instead of letting the wave and ghouls snowball the lane.
monster-rounds.watch: Better clear does not make an unsafe angle safe. Check the position before committing to attack enemy setup.
monster-rounds.buy: Buy it early when summon or minion pressure makes farming and clearing unsafe. Upgrade only when you need more than the basic clear, and keep using cover while dismantling the setup.

best.note: Graves summons are overwhelming lane before you can afford Ricochet
methods: Buy Monster Rounds as the cheaper early answer.
Extra damage into NPCs and summons helps you clear her spawned pressure sooner instead of letting the wave and ghouls snowball the lane.

best.note: McGinnis turrets are taking over every objective area
methods: Buy Monster Rounds early and upgrade to Cultist Sacrifice if the summon problem persists.
Both directly improve your ability to clear player-created NPCs, and Cultist Sacrifice can consume Mini Turrets.

best.note: Rem Lil Helpers are stealing farm and taking over the lane
methods: Buy Monster Rounds and clear Lil Helpers quickly.
Removing the summoned/resource pressure keeps Rem from turning lane control into free farm and reduces the healing/support value the helpers create.

alts.text: Cultist Sacrifice turns enemy setup into an opportunity. Building on Monster Rounds, it improves NPC pressure and can consume eligible summons for souls and a lasting buff, making it particularly useful when McGinnis keeps building turret positions.

Ricochet spreads weapon pressure to nearby targets, helping gun builds handle clustered enemies and summons. Its counter value grows when an enemy setup gives you several useful targets to hit from one safe angle, rather than a single isolated opponent.

Alchemical Fire helps dismantle the space an enemy team wants to fight from. Its area damage is especially useful against clustered summons: clear the setup first, then take the fight on ground that favors you.

proc-silence.name: Глушитель
proc-silence.short: Weapon hits weaken spirit damage and build toward silence.
proc-silence.intro: Ability-reliant targets that your weapon can keep in range.
proc-silence.who: Weapon users who can consistently land hits on an ability-reliant opponent.
proc-silence.when: Keep landing weapon hits to build the silence before the defensive or escape cast matters. If you need cast denial immediately, compare a direct active such as Silence Wave.
proc-silence.example: Against Lady Geist: Build the silence before the swap can rescue her. Keep enough weapon access to apply it, rather than assuming it is a reaction after the cast.
proc-silence.watch: The silence needs weapon buildup and access to the target. It is not an instant response or a substitute for a interrupt against an already-started channel.
proc-silence.buy: Consider it when your weapon build has reliable target access and needs ongoing cast pressure. If the next ability must be stopped immediately, compare a direct active instead of waiting for weapon buildup.
why: Helps deny a defensive or escape cast once the silence builds up

best.note: A low-health target can still use the health swap
methods: Build the silence before the swap can rescue her. Keep enough weapon access to apply it, rather than assuming it is a reaction after the cast.

best.note: You can maintain weapon hits while denying his next cast
methods: Consider weapon-based silence if your build can sustain the application. Compare a direct Silence Wave when you need a more immediate denial window.

alts.text: Silence Wave creates a cast-denial window before an enemy uses an important ability. Land the projectile as your team is ready to commit, then punish while escape or defensive casts are restricted. A silence is not a universal answer to an already-running channel.

Cursed Relic creates a powerful team focus-fire window by interrupting, silencing, disarming, locking items, and removing non-ultimate buffs. Its outgoing-damage penalty makes allied follow-up central to the purchase: choose the target together and be ready to punish.

Disarming Hex stops a target from firing their weapon, creating breathing room against gun-focused carries. It is particularly useful when your team wants to keep fighting through the enemy's damage window rather than only protect one player.

metal-skin.name: Металлическая кожа
metal-skin.short: Temporary bullet immunity for the enemy's decisive weapon commitment.
metal-skin.intro: Committed weapon bursts and ultimates whose main damage source is bullets.
metal-skin.who: Players who need a short defensive window against decisive bullet damage.
metal-skin.when: Activate it for the weapon damage that would otherwise decide the fight, then use the immunity window to reach cover, reposition, or let your team respond.
metal-skin.example: Against Drifter: Activate Metal Skin during the committed weapon burst. It gives a temporary bullet-immunity window that can completely waste the part of Drifter's all-in that depends on sustained gun damage.
metal-skin.watch: Bullet immunity does not cleanse an existing debuff or stop every weapon on-hit buildup. The active also penalizes movement, so plan your position and the next response rather than assuming a free escape.
metal-skin.buy: Buy it when enemy bullet damage kills you before you can play the fight. You can move it ahead of a damage upgrade if surviving the next weapon commitment is what lets your build contribute.
why: A short bullet-immunity window against Haze or Silver’s Wolf Form
Use the window to reposition or commit with follow-up; other damage and debuffs can still matter

best.note: Drifter gun burst is too high even after you survive the mark
methods: Activate Metal Skin during the committed weapon burst.
It gives a temporary bullet-immunity window that can completely waste the part of Drifter's all-in that depends on sustained gun damage.

best.note: Her ultimate is shredding your team
methods: Activate Metal Skin during the ultimate or interrupt her with Knockdown before Unstoppable.
Bullet immunity directly denies the main damage source while the ultimate is active.

best.note: Her gun pressure is melting you while you clear turrets
methods: Activate Metal Skin during the commit.
Bullet immunity lets you survive the window where you are exposed while removing the structures that are actually controlling the space.

best.note: Mirage weapon damage is melting you after the mark or tornado setup
methods: Use Metal Skin during the committed weapon burst.
Dispel Magic solves the debuffs, but Metal Skin is the better answer when the follow-up gun damage itself is what is finishing you.

best.note: Wolf form is running you down in every all-in
methods: Use Metal Skin during the transformation pressure.
Much of the lethal sequence depends on sustained weapon damage, and temporary bullet immunity can waste the strongest part of the form.

best.note: His weapon damage is deleting you in straight duels
methods: Activate Metal Skin during the all-in.
Venator is overwhelmingly gun-dependent, and bullet immunity can deny even his ultimate damage window.

alts.text: Plated Armor offers passive chances to deflect bullets and prevent weapon on-hit effects. Against repeated gun hits and stacking pressure, it can slow the buildup that makes the exchange dangerous, while leaving you free to manage positioning and other actives.

Disarming Hex stops a target from firing their weapon, creating breathing room against gun-focused carries. It is particularly useful when your team wants to keep fighting through the enemy's damage window rather than only protect one player.

Ethereal Shift lets you sit out a dangerous moment through brief invulnerability and untargetability. Against a committed burst or a short ultimate window, the goal is to waste the enemy's investment and return with a plan for your next position.

endurance.name: Добавочное восстановление
endurance.short: Restores health between lane trades to preserve farming time.
endurance.intro: Repeated lane poke that forces you off resources before a full fight begins.
endurance.who: Laning heroes whose health is being worn down between exchanges and who need to preserve farming time.
endurance.when: Use the recovery to stabilize the lane between trades. Combine it with cover and a change of angle so the next poke does not immediately undo the recovery.
endurance.watch: Recovery does not stop a burst combo at the moment it lands. If each catch is lethal, choose a defense for that immediate threat.
endurance.buy: Buy it early when repeated poke forces you away from farm. If the enemy kills you in one combo, recovery between trades should give way to an answer that helps you survive the combo itself.
why: Protect lane farm when sustained chip damage is forcing you out

alts.text: Healing Rite helps you recover between fights and return to lane with enough health to contest farm. It works best when you can step out of the enemy's pressure, complete the recovery safely, and avoid returning to the same exposed angle.

Restorative Locket turns accumulated stacks into a self-heal, helping you stay present through repeated exchanges. The reset is most useful when it gives you enough health to keep farming or rejoin a fight from a better angle.

Reactive Barrier adds an automatic shield after a hard-control catch. It helps absorb the follow-up damage that often turns a stun into a kill, giving you a chance to reach cover or receive help once you can act again.

non-player-bonus-sacrifice.name: Жертвенный ритуал
non-player-bonus-sacrifice.short: Improves NPC clear and consumes eligible summons for rewards.
non-player-bonus-sacrifice.intro: Summon-heavy positions, including McGinnis turrets, Rem helpers, and Graves summon pressure.
non-player-bonus-sacrifice.who: Players who need sustained NPC and summon clear, with opportunities to use the consume active safely.
non-player-bonus-sacrifice.when: Remove valuable enemy summons before they contribute through the fight. Against McGinnis, the consume opportunity can turn turret setup into a resource gain.
non-player-bonus-sacrifice.example: Against McGinnis: Upgrade into Cultist Sacrifice when summon control is deciding objectives. It is a higher-commitment anti-summon answer that can remove Mini Turrets and turn entrenched turret setups into extra value instead of a permanent zone.
non-player-bonus-sacrifice.watch: Not every Graves object can be consumed. Check the target rather than assuming all created objects behave alike.
non-player-bonus-sacrifice.buy: Upgrade when summon pressure is recurring and there are safe opportunities to consume eligible targets. Start with Monster Rounds if affordable clear is all you need right now.
why: Directly punishes McGinnis Mini Turrets and Rem helpers
Also improves summon clear against Graves; not every Graves object can be consumed

best.note: McGinnis turret nest is too expensive or slow to clear one turret at a time
methods: Upgrade into Cultist Sacrifice when summon control is deciding objectives.
It is a higher-commitment anti-summon answer that can remove Mini Turrets and turn entrenched turret setups into extra value instead of a permanent zone.

alts.text: Monster Rounds helps you clear minions and summons before they take control of your lane or a fight. Against enemy setup, removing the extra targets first can be more effective than trying to damage the hero while every summon is still active.

Ricochet spreads weapon pressure to nearby targets, helping gun builds handle clustered enemies and summons. Its counter value grows when an enemy setup gives you several useful targets to hit from one safe angle, rather than a single isolated opponent.

Alchemical Fire helps dismantle the space an enemy team wants to fight from. Its area damage is especially useful against clustered summons: clear the setup first, then take the fight on ground that favors you.

greater-withering-whip.name: Чары обезоруживания
greater-withering-whip.short: Stops an enemy from firing during their weapon-damage window.
greater-withering-whip.intro: Weapon-focused carries and close weapon windows, including Silver's wolf-form pressure.
greater-withering-whip.who: Players who need to interrupt enemy weapon pressure and create a team follow-up window.
greater-withering-whip.when: Use it when the enemy is ready to deliver the weapon damage that matters, then punish or reposition during the disruption.
greater-withering-whip.example: Against Celeste: Disarm her once she commits. Celeste can function like a gun carry after her abilities create the opening, so turning off the weapon removes a major part of the follow-up.
greater-withering-whip.watch: A weapon stop does not provide a blanket answer to damaging abilities or an existing debuff. Check which part of the opponent's build is winning the fight.
greater-withering-whip.buy: Buy it when weapon damage is deciding fights and you can safely target the carry. Check their build first: a disarm offers much less relief against damage coming primarily from abilities.

best.note: I need to disrupt her Threadsap-empowered shooting
methods: Use Disarming Hex during her gun commitment, or Suppressor if you can consistently deal spirit damage to her.
Disarming Hex stops weapon fire, denying shots that would carry Threadsap’s bonus spirit damage. Suppressor reduces fire rate through spirit damage. Neither stops her abilities or melee attacks.

best.note: Her weapon damage is carrying fights after the spell setup
methods: Disarm her once she commits.
Celeste can function like a gun carry after her abilities create the opening, so turning off the weapon removes a major part of the follow-up.

best.note: His gun damage is melting you during the isolated all-in
methods: Disarm him when he commits to the duel.
Drifter is heavily weapon-dependent and loses most of his damage while he cannot fire.

best.note: You need a team weapon stop while Haze is committing damage
methods: Have a teammate use Disarming Hex during the committed weapon window; use Metal Skin when your own immediate survival is the priority.
A team disarm and personal bullet immunity serve different roles, and the buyer needs a safe opportunity to apply the answer.

best.note: His gun build is carrying after the ability setup
methods: Disarm him during the damage window.
A gun-oriented Seven loses a large portion of his sustained damage while he cannot fire.

best.note: Her claws and gun pressure are the real damage source
methods: Disarm her once she commits.
Turning off the weapon removes the damage pattern that keeps the transformation on top of you.

best.note: You need to stop him shooting rather than just survive it
methods: Disarm him when he commits.
If he cannot fire his weapon, most of the character's damage output disappears for the duration.

alts.text: Metal Skin gives you a temporary bullet-immunity window against decisive weapon pressure. Against a gun carry, activate it for the dangerous commitment and use that time to reach cover or let allies respond; it does not remove debuffs already on you.

Rusted Barrel reduces an enemy's fire rate, making sustained gun trades easier to manage. Apply it during the exchange you want to change, then use the reduced weapon pressure to contest the wave, reposition, or return damage.

Cursed Relic creates a powerful team focus-fire window by interrupting, silencing, disarming, locking items, and removing non-ultimate buffs. Its outgoing-damage penalty makes allied follow-up central to the purchase: choose the target together and be ready to punish.

self-bubble.name: Развоплощение
self-bubble.short: Brief invulnerability and untargetability to avoid committed damage.
self-bubble.intro: Committed burst and short dangerous windows where temporarily leaving the exchange helps.
self-bubble.who: Players who need to avoid a committed damage window and can plan where to go afterward.
self-bubble.when: Use the brief invulnerability and untargetability to waste the enemy's commitment or wait through a dangerous window, then reposition before pressure resumes.
self-bubble.example: Against Calico: Use Ethereal Shift during the committed damage window. Invulnerability lets you wait out the most dangerous part of the sequence instead of trying to outrun it.
self-bubble.watch: The protection is brief. If you remain in the same losing position afterward, the next part of the fight can recreate the problem.
self-bubble.buy: Buy it when a specific burst or ultimate window is the reason you die, even after improving your positioning. You need time to activate it and a safe plan for when the protection ends.
why: Wait out stun windows like Wraith lift

best.note: The final part of her ultimate is finishing you
methods: Use Ethereal Shift during the committed damage window.
Invulnerability lets you wait out the most dangerous part of the sequence instead of trying to outrun it.

best.note: You are trapped inside Frozen Shelter with him
methods: Use Ethereal Shift to wait out part of the dome.
Invulnerability can burn a large portion of the shelter duration without feeding him free damage or healing value.

best.note: Ground Slam and Flog burst are deleting you on entry
methods: Ethereal Shift as the committed burst lands.
Lash has already spent the mobility to enter, so making the slam deal zero damage can leave him stranded in front of you.

alts.text: Counterspell rewards reading an enemy's commitment. By upgrading your parry to block ability damage and effects during its protection window, it lets you turn a predictable burst or control attempt into a missed opportunity for the opponent.

Warp Stone gives you an immediate position change and bullet resistance, helping escape a close threat or committed damage angle. Pick a destination that removes follow-up pressure; teleporting within the same danger wastes much of the opportunity.

Metal Skin gives you a temporary bullet-immunity window against decisive weapon pressure. Against a gun carry, activate it for the dangerous commitment and use that time to reach cover or let allies respond; it does not remove debuffs already on you.

reduce-debuff-duration.name: Развеивание магии
reduce-debuff-duration.short: Clears non-ultimate debuffs; unavailable while stunned or slept.
reduce-debuff-duration.intro: Removable marks, burns, roots, slows, and item debuffs.
reduce-debuff-duration.who: Players whose fights are being lost to removable non-ultimate debuffs, especially several effects at once.
reduce-debuff-duration.when: Use it after the important removable effects are applied and before recommitting. A clean reset can keep the next exchange from starting with accumulated pressure.
reduce-debuff-duration.example: Against Bebop: Use Dispel Magic before detonation. Sticky Bomb is a non-ultimate debuff and can be purged, dropping the bomb instead of eating the full burst.
reduce-debuff-duration.watch: It cannot be activated while Stunned or Slept and does not remove ultimate negative effects. Do not buy it as a universal hard-control escape.
reduce-debuff-duration.buy: Buy it as soon as a removable debuff repeatedly costs you a trade or a death. Do not wait for a typical purchase minute when a cleanse would let you survive the next bomb or damage-over-time sequence.
why: Clean answer to removable marks, burns, roots, slows, and item debuffs
Especially valuable when several non-ultimate debuffs are stacked at once

best.note: Bebop Sticky Bomb is attached and about to detonate
methods: Use Dispel Magic before detonation.
Sticky Bomb is a non-ultimate debuff and can be purged, dropping the bomb instead of eating the full burst.

best.note: The Wrecked debuff is making his follow-up hit too hard
methods: Purge Wrecked with Dispel Magic.
Removing the debuff cuts the damage amplification that makes his next sequence so punishing.

best.note: Light Eater stacks are enabling too much follow-up damage
methods: Purge the Light Eater debuff with Dispel Magic.
Removing the setup debuff cuts a large portion of the damage her next sequence is built around.

best.note: Stalker's Mark and other debuffs keep setting up his kills
methods: Purge the mark as soon as the engage is committed.
Drifter relies heavily on debuff-driven pressure, and Dispel Magic removes the tracking/setup that lets him convert the all-in.

best.note: Her wall or debuffs keep trapping you in bad fights
methods: Use Dispel Magic when the non-ultimate control/debuff is applied.
Purging the effect restores your ability to move and prevents the follow-up from being guaranteed.

best.note: Grey Talon traps keep rooting you for free charged shots
methods: Use Dispel Magic on removable trap/root pressure.
Cleansing the setup denies the stationary target Grey Talon needs for an easy charged shot or follow-up burst.

alts.text: Debuff Reducer helps you spend less of each fight under status effects. It is a passive answer to repeated disruption, useful when shorter debuffs give you room to move or trade without relying on another active button.

Divine Barrier turns a defensive purchase into a teammate save. Its shield and debuff purge can protect an ally during a dangerous sequence, including removable bomb pressure, when you keep a clear view and a usable save angle.

Unstoppable protects a planned commitment from crowd control. Activate it before the dangerous control sequence begins, especially when repeated disables would stop you from completing an engage or dealing damage. You still need a position that survives the incoming damage.

phantom-strike.name: Фантомный удар
phantom-strike.short: Teleports to an enemy, then grounds, slows, and disarms them.
phantom-strike.intro: Aerial backliners, with Vindicta as the explicit gap-closing example.
phantom-strike.who: Heroes that can safely commit into an enemy position and use the grounding and disarm window.
phantom-strike.when: Use it when the aerial target is reachable and your own hero can survive the arrival. Coordinate damage so the commit converts the temporary weapon denial.
phantom-strike.example: Against Vindicta: Use Phantom Strike from a hero that can safely commit. It teleports directly to her, pulls her down, and disarms her, immediately turning the range advantage into close pressure.
phantom-strike.watch: It commits you to the target's position. Against Vindicta, make sure your hero can survive the arrival and finish the exchange.
phantom-strike.buy: Consider it when your hero can safely reach and finish an otherwise inaccessible target. Buy for a planned engage with follow-up, rather than using an expensive commitment to chase into an enemy team.
why: Powerful gap-closer into aerial backliners such as Vindicta
Immediately removes the target's weapon during the commit window

best.note: Your team cannot reach her before she escapes
methods: Use Phantom Strike from a hero that can safely commit.
It teleports directly to her, pulls her down, and disarms her, immediately turning the range advantage into close pressure.

alts.text: Knockdown gives your team a delayed stun to punish airborne targets and interrupt vulnerable channels. The delay is the key detail: cast while there is still time for the stun to land, and have damage ready when the target is controlled.

Slowing Hex is a targeted answer to movement-dependent escapes. Use the slow and movement-skill silence before the relevant escape begins, with allies already in range to punish; a catch has little value if no one can finish the target.

Disarming Hex stops a target from firing their weapon, creating breathing room against gun-focused carries. It is particularly useful when your team wants to keep fighting through the enemy's damage window rather than only protect one player.

capacitor.name: Конденсатор
capacitor.short: Pins targets by restricting stamina and movement tools.
capacitor.intro: Mobile targets such as Calico that repeatedly escape your team's damage range.
capacitor.who: Weapon-focused builds that benefit from its shock and farming effects as well as the active control. Consider the full investment before choosing it solely to catch one target.
capacitor.when: Use the pinning window when allies are in damage range. A movement-control purchase is most useful when it turns an escape into a fight your team can finish.
capacitor.example: Against Calico: Use the active movement and stamina denial while your team can finish the catch. Favor it on a build that already values the weapon and farming side of the item.
capacitor.watch: A disabled escape route is only part of securing a kill. If your team cannot reach the target, you may spend the control without converting it.
capacitor.buy: Consider it when your weapon build benefits from the shock effects and your team also needs a stronger catch. If you only need movement denial, compare Slowing Hex before committing to the larger purchase.
why: Pins down slippery targets for a follow-up window
Fits builds that also benefit from its weapon and farming effects

best.note: She keeps escaping your damage window
methods: Use the active movement and stamina denial while your team can finish the catch. Favor it on a build that already values the weapon and farming side of the item.

alts.text: Slowing Hex is a targeted answer to movement-dependent escapes. Use the slow and movement-skill silence before the relevant escape begins, with allies already in range to punish; a catch has little value if no one can finish the target.

Knockdown gives your team a delayed stun to punish airborne targets and interrupt vulnerable channels. The delay is the key detail: cast while there is still time for the stun to land, and have damage ready when the target is controlled.

Silence Wave creates a cast-denial window before an enemy uses an important ability. Land the projectile as your team is ready to commit, then punish while escape or defensive casts are restricted. A silence is not a universal answer to an already-running channel.

ricochet.name: Рикошет
ricochet.short: Spreads weapon damage to nearby enemies and summons.
ricochet.intro: Grouped summons around a main target, with Graves as the explicit clear example.
ricochet.who: Weapon builds facing multiple nearby targets or grouped summon pressure.
ricochet.when: Attack from an angle where the extra hits can clear clustered resources while you keep pressure on the main target.
ricochet.example: Against Graves: Use Ricochet on a weapon build, or Monster Rounds for a more accessible summon-clear option. Clearing grouped summons reduces Graves’s resource pressure, but a weapon investment needs to fit your own hero and build.
ricochet.watch: The additional targets take reduced damage. Its clear value depends on targets being close enough together, not just on the presence of one tough enemy.
ricochet.buy: Consider it when your weapon build also needs clear against grouped summons or nearby enemies. If the immediate problem is one lane summon, compare a smaller clear purchase before delaying core damage.
why: Excellent weapon-side clear into Graves summon waves
Useful when multiple summons are grouped around the main target

best.note: Ghouls and skull summons are taking over the lane
methods: Use Ricochet on a weapon build, or Monster Rounds for a more accessible summon-clear option.
Clearing grouped summons reduces Graves’s resource pressure, but a weapon investment needs to fit your own hero and build.

alts.text: Monster Rounds helps you clear minions and summons before they take control of your lane or a fight. Against enemy setup, removing the extra targets first can be more effective than trying to damage the hero while every summon is still active.

Cultist Sacrifice turns enemy setup into an opportunity. Building on Monster Rounds, it improves NPC pressure and can consume eligible summons for souls and a lasting buff, making it particularly useful when McGinnis keeps building turret positions.

Alchemical Fire helps dismantle the space an enemy team wants to fight from. Its area damage is especially useful against clustered summons: clear the setup first, then take the fight on ground that favors you.

bullet-resist-shredder.name: Измельчитель пулестойкости
bullet-resist-shredder.short: Reduces enemy bullet resistance for stronger weapon follow-up.
bullet-resist-shredder.intro: Frontliners whose bullet resistance is extending weapon trades.
bullet-resist-shredder.who: Weapon carries and teams that can follow up with bullet damage on the same target.
bullet-resist-shredder.when: Apply the resistance reduction while your team can shoot the target. Its value is tied to the weapon damage you can deliver during that pressure window.
bullet-resist-shredder.example: Against Mo & Krill: Apply bullet-resistance reduction with coordinated weapon follow-up. The item guide source identifies Mo & Krill as a useful resistance-shred matchup; weapon damage needs access to the target to convert that reduction.
bullet-resist-shredder.watch: Reducing bullet resistance does not cleanse your debuffs or prevent the enemy from escaping. Secure access and follow-up separately.
bullet-resist-shredder.buy: Buy it when your team has meaningful weapon follow-up but targets survive that pressure. It is most useful before coordinated fights where several allies can shoot the same enemy.
why: Improves team weapon pressure into bullet resistance
Useful against durable targets your weapon users can keep in range

best.note: Mo & Krill defensive resistance is extending the weapon trade
methods: Apply bullet-resistance reduction with coordinated weapon follow-up.
The item guide source identifies Mo & Krill as a useful resistance-shred matchup; weapon damage needs access to the target to convert that reduction.

alts.text: Armor Piercer gives weapon carries a way to pressure enemies protected by bullet resistance or barriers. Its bullet procs bypass those defenses, making sustained shooting more useful against a target that ordinary weapon damage struggles to finish.

Tank Buster helps damage remain useful against large health pools through percentage current-health damage that bypasses spirit resistance. It addresses durability, while healing and defensive casts may still require separate answers from you or your team.

Siphon Bullets creates a temporary health swing through repeated weapon hits, stealing a percentage of the enemy's maximum health. Against a large-health target, sustained contact and a coordinated finish help convert that temporary advantage before the stolen health returns.

melee-rebuttal.name: Отпор
melee-rebuttal.short: Rewards successful parries and reduces parry cooldown.
melee-rebuttal.intro: Parryable close-range pressure, especially Abrams, Billy, and Viscous matchups.
melee-rebuttal.who: Players who can identify and parry the melee attack that is deciding their lane trades.
melee-rebuttal.when: Prepare the parry for the real melee event, then use the improved parry rhythm to deny repeat attacks. Teammate parry coverage can help when your own parry was baited.
melee-rebuttal.example: Against Abrams: Buy Rebuttal and play around your parry. The shorter parry cooldown and melee-focused stats punish the repeated melee pattern Abrams wants.
melee-rebuttal.watch: The benefit still depends on a successful parry. Do not treat every dash or damage event as a melee attack you can answer the same way.
melee-rebuttal.buy: Buy it when repeated melee trades are costing health or farm and you can land the parry. It can be worth prioritizing in lane against melee pressure rather than waiting for later fights.

best.note: Abrams melee pressure is winning every lane trade
methods: Buy Rebuttal and play around your parry.
The shorter parry cooldown and melee-focused stats punish the repeated melee pattern Abrams wants.

best.note: He is winning every melee trade in lane
methods: Buy Rebuttal and save your parry for the actual melee.
Billy frequently chains light melees into his pressure, and the shorter parry cooldown makes that pattern much riskier.

best.note: Puddle Punch is winning every close-range trade
methods: Parry the punch with Rebuttal.
Successful parries heal you, return damage, and create a damage-amplified punish window against the repeated melee-style interaction.

best.note: Granny Long Legs kicks and ground slams are winning her lane trades
methods: Time your parry for the kick or ground slam, and consider Rebuttal early if this pressure keeps costing you health or farm.

Both attacks can be parried. Her kick stuns Baba when parried, while her ground slam does not. Rebuttal rewards successful parries and shortens the parry cooldown, helping you answer repeated melee pressure.

alts.text: Reactive Barrier adds an automatic shield after a hard-control catch. It helps absorb the follow-up damage that often turns a stun into a kill, giving you a chance to reach cover or receive help once you can act again.

Extra Stamina gives you more movement decisions in a fight. An additional dash or air movement option can be the difference between dodging a readable threat and having nothing left after spending stamina to farm or trade.

Warp Stone gives you an immediate position change and bullet resistance, helping escape a close threat or committed damage angle. Pick a destination that removes follow-up pressure; teleporting within the same danger wastes much of the opportunity.

thermal-detonator.name: Алхимический огонь
thermal-detonator.short: Area damage that clears clustered summons and pressures enemy positions.
thermal-detonator.intro: Grouped turrets and enemies holding a small area; McGinnis is the named turret matchup.
thermal-detonator.who: Players who need an area answer to a built-up enemy position, especially grouped summons.
thermal-detonator.when: Use the area damage where it can remove several turrets or deny a route the enemy wants to hold. Clear the setup before committing the main fight.
thermal-detonator.example: Against McGinnis: Use Alchemical Fire from a safe angle on grouped turrets. Its area damage can clear several parts of the setup while denying the ground McGinnis wants to hold.
thermal-detonator.watch: An area-clear purchase still needs a safe angle. Do not stand inside the enemy setup just because you can damage it.
thermal-detonator.buy: Buy it when grouped turrets or summons keep blocking your team's approach. Prioritize it before the next push into that setup, rather than after you have already committed inside it.

best.note: Grouped McGinnis turrets need an area-clear answer
methods: Use Alchemical Fire from a safe angle on grouped turrets.
Its area damage can clear several parts of the setup while denying the ground McGinnis wants to hold.

alts.text: Monster Rounds helps you clear minions and summons before they take control of your lane or a fight. Against enemy setup, removing the extra targets first can be more effective than trying to damage the hero while every summon is still active.

Cultist Sacrifice turns enemy setup into an opportunity. Building on Monster Rounds, it improves NPC pressure and can consume eligible summons for souls and a lasting buff, making it particularly useful when McGinnis keeps building turret positions.

Ricochet spreads weapon pressure to nearby targets, helping gun builds handle clustered enemies and summons. Its counter value grows when an enemy setup gives you several useful targets to hit from one safe angle, rather than a single isolated opponent.

magic-slow.name: Мистическое замедление
magic-slow.short: Ability damage slows targets for easier follow-up or kiting.
magic-slow.intro: Mobile opponents that you can consistently reach with ability damage.
magic-slow.who: Ability users who can keep applying spirit pressure and want that damage to help hold targets in range.
magic-slow.when: Apply it while allies can follow up or while you need space from a chase. Its value depends on your ability damage reaching the target.
magic-slow.example: Against Celeste: Use ability-applied slowing to create a follow-up window. Coordinate damage during that window rather than expecting the slow to secure a kill alone.
magic-slow.watch: A slow is not a universal movement-skill shutdown. A target with an available escape may need a more specific denial tool.
magic-slow.buy: Buy it when your spirit damage connects but targets keep walking out of follow-up range. If a movement ability is the escape you must stop, compare Slowing Hex instead of relying on a slow alone.

best.note: You can reach her with abilities but struggle to keep her in range
methods: Use ability-applied slowing to create a follow-up window. Coordinate damage during that window rather than expecting the slow to secure a kill alone.

best.note: Her movement makes repeated ability follow-up difficult
methods: Consider ability-applied slowing when your spirit damage can reach her consistently. Track defensive movement before investing your decisive disable.

alts.text: Slowing Hex is a targeted answer to movement-dependent escapes. Use the slow and movement-skill silence before the relevant escape begins, with allies already in range to punish; a catch has little value if no one can finish the target.

Suppressor lets spirit-damage users reduce an enemy's fire rate through their damage pressure. It is useful when your spirit damage can reach a gun carry consistently, helping your team trade with less sustained weapon pressure.

Capacitor combines weapon-build value with a targeted catch. Its projectile slows an enemy, prevents stamina usage, and restricts movement abilities and items, giving your team a window to punish a target that normally escapes.

reinforcing-casings.name: Растущая стойкость
reinforcing-casings.short: Builds bullet resistance while you keep shooting.
reinforcing-casings.who: Weapon users who can keep shooting during an extended trade and benefit from building bullet resistance.
reinforcing-casings.when: Choose it for fights where you can maintain fire and let the defensive value build through the exchange.
reinforcing-casings.watch: The resistance builds as you shoot. A short burst or a fight where you cannot attack may not give the same value as a consistent passive defense.
reinforcing-casings.buy: Consider it when your fights are extended weapon trades and you have enough uptime to build the resistance. Against sudden burst or a disable that prevents shooting, compare a more immediate defense.

alts.text: Plated Armor offers passive chances to deflect bullets and prevent weapon on-hit effects. Against repeated gun hits and stacking pressure, it can slow the buildup that makes the exchange dangerous, while leaving you free to manage positioning and other actives.

Metal Skin gives you a temporary bullet-immunity window against decisive weapon pressure. Against a gun carry, activate it for the dangerous commitment and use that time to reach cover or let allies respond; it does not remove debuffs already on you.

Weapon Shielding creates a barrier after a burst of weapon damage, helping absorb follow-up pressure. Use that shield window to reach cover or return a manageable trade instead of staying exposed until the next burst overwhelms you.

tech-purge.name: Спиритическая стойкость
tech-purge.short: Passive resistance against recurring spirit damage.
tech-purge.intro: Repeated spell pressure and spirit-heavy builds.
tech-purge.who: Players who need consistent passive durability against ability damage.
tech-purge.when: Choose it when spirit damage is recurring through several exchanges and you need a baseline defense to continue playing the fight.
tech-purge.example: Against Calico: Build Spirit Resilience or Spellbreaker. Her dangerous burst is heavily spirit-based, so dedicated spirit defense buys time to survive the combo.
tech-purge.watch: It does not cleanse effects or prevent the next catch. If control or weapon damage is the main cause of the loss, choose an answer for that threat.
tech-purge.buy: Buy it when recurring ability damage is the main reason you cannot stay in fights. Check the opponent's actual build so you do not spend on spirit defense against a weapon-led damage pattern.

best.note: Her full spirit combo is bursting you too quickly
methods: Build Spirit Resilience or Spellbreaker.
Her dangerous burst is heavily spirit-based, so dedicated spirit defense buys time to survive the combo.

best.note: Barrel burst is the part actually killing you
methods: Build spirit resistance instead of overbuying Lasso counters.
If the displacement is survivable but the barrel damage is not, direct spirit defense solves the real problem.

best.note: Lash spirit damage is too high even when you avoid Death Slam
methods: Build Spirit Resilience when raw spirit burst is the recurring problem.
Ground Slam and Flog can still remove huge chunks of health without the ultimate, so dedicated spirit resistance raises your margin for error.

best.note: Seven spirit damage is chunking you even when Static Charge is not the issue
methods: Build Spirit Resilience when Lightning Ball and other spirit damage are the real threat.
Dispel Magic answers Static Charge, but dedicated spirit resistance is the better purchase when you are simply losing too much health to repeated spell damage.

best.note: Power Slash and the rest of her spirit burst are chunking too hard
methods: Build Spirit Resilience or Spellbreaker when spirit burst is deciding the fight.
