Dedicated spirit defense buys time against the burst, while cover and movement still matter.

alts.text: Spellbreaker helps against spirit-heavy burst through spirit and debuff resistance plus periodic mitigation of a large spirit hit. Its protection is most valuable when available for the ability that matters, rather than spent on an earlier qualifying hit.

Spirit Shielding creates a barrier after a burst of spirit damage, helping absorb what follows. It is useful when the opening ability hit starts a dangerous trade and a shield gives you time to reach cover or return manageable damage.

Ethereal Shift lets you sit out a dangerous moment through brief invulnerability and untargetability. Against a committed burst or a short ultimate window, the goal is to waste the enemy's investment and return with a plan for your next position.

spirit-bubble.name: Спиритическая защита
spirit-bubble.short: Grants a barrier after a burst of spirit damage.
spirit-bubble.intro: Ability-driven lane burst and repeated caster pressure.
spirit-bubble.who: Laning players who need a barrier response to ability damage so a burst exchange is survivable.
spirit-bubble.when: Use the barrier's protection to reach cover or improve the trade angle after the ability hit.
spirit-bubble.example: Against Grey Talon: Consider Spirit Shielding and stay near hard cover for the next shot. A significant spirit burst can trigger the barrier, helping stabilize the exchange without treating the purchase as permission to remain exposed.
spirit-bubble.watch: Spirit damage is the trigger; the resulting barrier can absorb other incoming damage too. A barrier does not deny the cast, and the follow-up may still need movement or control protection.
spirit-bubble.buy: Consider it when ability poke or burst repeatedly opens the enemy's winning trade. The trigger must be relevant to your matchup; compare other protection when weapon damage is the main opener.

best.note: Grey Talon charged shots are forcing you out of lane
methods: Consider Spirit Shielding and stay near hard cover for the next shot.
A significant spirit burst can trigger the barrier, helping stabilize the exchange without treating the purchase as permission to remain exposed.

best.note: Her spirit burst is overwhelming you in lane
methods: Buy Spirit Shielding or another early sustain option.
The barrier helps stop repeated spirit poke from becoming a snowball before you have larger defensive items.

best.note: The Doorman Call Bell poke is chunking you out of lane
methods: Buy Spirit Shielding for early spell protection.
If Call Bell and other spirit poke are the problem rather than Doorway itself, an early spirit barrier is a cheaper way to stay in lane and keep farming.

best.note: Viscous Splatter bounce damage is crushing you in tight spaces
methods: Use Spirit Shielding when repeated spirit poke is the problem and avoid enclosed geometry.
The barrier reduces the burst while better positioning prevents Splatter from getting multiple high-value bounces.

alts.text: Spirit Resilience provides consistent passive protection against spirit damage. It helps when abilities keep wearing you down across multiple exchanges, giving you a baseline defense while you focus on positioning, cooldowns, and your own contribution to the fight.

Spellbreaker helps against spirit-heavy burst through spirit and debuff resistance plus periodic mitigation of a large spirit hit. Its protection is most valuable when available for the ability that matters, rather than spent on an earlier qualifying hit.

Reactive Barrier adds an automatic shield after a hard-control catch. It helps absorb the follow-up damage that often turns a stun into a kill, giving you a chance to reach cover or receive help once you can act again.

inhibitor.name: Ограничитель
inhibitor.short: Bullet buildup cuts a target’s outgoing damage and healing.
inhibitor.intro: Gun carries and brawlers whose damage and healing both win long fights.
inhibitor.who: Weapon users who can maintain successful hits on the opponent deciding the fight.
inhibitor.when: Build the debuff before the enemy’s damage and recovery take over, with teammates ready to follow up.
inhibitor.watch: Bullet buildup requires target access. This is not an instant interrupt, disarm, cleanse or emergency protection against burst that lands first.
inhibitor.buy: Consider it when damage suppression and anti-heal are both useful. Choose a cheaper anti-heal source if recovery alone is the problem, or immediate protection if you die before applying the effect.
why: 30% outgoing-damage and 40% healing reduction once built up
Needs safe, sustained bullet contact with the target

best.note: A fed gun build wins sustained trades, especially with lifesteal.
methods: Apply before the weapon commitment from a safe angle; do not rely on buildup as an emergency save.
Alternative: Metal Skin for personal bullet survival; Disarming Hex for a weapon stop.

best.note: Damage and healing keep winning close fights.
methods: Keep bullet contact from outside melee range before your team commits.
Alternative: Rebuttal for punches; Toxic Bullets or Decay for health and healing.

best.note: Gun damage and lifesteal overwhelm prolonged trades.
methods: Maintain hits before or during allied focus; suppression does not prevent Telekinesis.
Alternative: Disarming Hex for shooting; control protection for the lift.

best.note: Repeated gun hits and lifesteal keep winning the fight.
methods: Maintain safe weapon contact before her buildup makes the next exchange lethal.
Alternative: Dispel Magic for eligible poison; gun defense for immediate survival.

best.note: Sustained weapon pressure and lifesteal decide her commitment.
methods: Apply before she is already on top of you; preserve a retreat route.
Alternative: Disarming Hex or Metal Skin for her decisive weapon window.

best.note: Last Stand recovery and damage decide the extended fight.
methods: Apply while your team can pressure him; stay out of his preferred close area.
Alternative: Anti-heal for recovery; Dispel Magic or movement for Binding Word.

alts.text: Toxic Bullets (3,200) applies anti-heal and maximum-health bleed through bullet buildup, but not Inhibitor’s outgoing-damage reduction.
Healbane (1,600) applies anti-heal through spirit damage. A gun build without reliable spirit damage may need another route.
Decay (3,200) is targeted current-health damage and anti-heal without bullet buildup. Its damage is non-lethal.
Disarming Hex (3,200) stops shooting and reduces bullet resist right away, instead of waiting for buildup.
Silencer (6,400) builds up to a silence and reduces outgoing spirit damage, which is different from Inhibitor’s general damage penalty.

banshee-slugs.name: Калечащий выстрел в голову
banshee-slugs.short: Headshots open a team damage window and cut healing.
banshee-slugs.intro: Durable targets whose resist and healing stop a coordinated finish.
banshee-slugs.who: Weapon users who can reliably land headshots on targets their teammates can attack.
banshee-slugs.when: Land the headshot before the team’s main damage. Follow through on the marked target instead of scattering pressure across unreachable enemies.
banshee-slugs.watch: Body shots do not apply it. The first headshot applies the debuff after its own damage. It neither strips barriers nor prevents defensive casts. Graves cannot purchase it under the current headshot restriction.
banshee-slugs.buy: Upgrade when headshot application is reliable and your team benefits from both resistance reduction and anti-heal. A large health pool by itself does not prove this is better than percentage-health damage.
why: Headshots reduce bullet and spirit resist and incoming healing
Needs reliable headshots and teammates to follow up

best.note: Healing and resistance make him survive focused damage.
methods: Headshot before allied gun and spirit damage; preserve spacing for melee.
Alternative: Toxic Bullets for health pressure; Rebuttal for punches.

best.note: A durable build remains difficult to finish after Royal Pestments is spent.
methods: Wait for a usable opening, then headshot before team damage. Anti-heal does not shrink the barrier.
Alternative: Tank Buster or Siphon Bullets for maximum-health pressure; Dispel Magic for rats.

best.note: Durability and Scorn recovery deny the finish.
methods: Mark him while exposed, before his close control removes your shooting opportunity.
Alternative: Toxic Bullets or Decay for large health and sustain.

best.note: Healing and resistance keep rescuing him during focus.
methods: Headshot for an actual team finish, avoiding isolated poke that only feeds another recovery cycle.
Alternative: Cheaper anti-heal first if healing is the only issue.

best.note: Last Stand healing and durability prevent a coordinated finish.
methods: Headshot while your team can follow through, then respect his close-range damage.
Alternative: Anti-heal alone may suffice; movement or cleanse answers cage.

best.note: Sustain and resistance let her survive outside her strongest defensive window.
methods: Headshot during a punishable window; do not expect it to strip an active ultimate.
Alternative: Silence before the cast; Healbane for a cheaper healing answer.

alts.text: Bullet Resist Shredder (1,600) lowers bullet resist through spirit damage, so gun follow-up works without a headshot.
Toxic Bullets (3,200) is easier if consistent body-shot buildup is more reliable than headshots.
Spirit Sap (1,600) reduces spirit power and spirit resist directly for spell trades.

grit.name: Крепость
grit.short: Cheap, manually timed barrier for a readable hit.
grit.intro: Readable lane bursts you can see coming and shield just before they land.
grit.who: Players who need inexpensive immediate protection and can time an active before damage arrives.
grit.when: Activate just before the important hit, then reposition. Cover and dodging remain the first response when available.
grit.watch: Protection lasts briefly and does not remove debuffs or prevent control. If a disable leaves no usable self-cast window, compare automatic protection.
grit.buy: Buy when a short, predictable trade is costing farm. Its sample supports lane and mid-game tags; later on, upgrade into the defense matching the actual threat.
why: A short barrier for 800 souls, timed before the hit
Upgrades into the shielding items or Guardian Ward later

best.note: One readable Sticky Bomb detonation costs too much lane health.
methods: Activate shortly before detonation, then reposition. It does not remove the bomb.
Alternative: Dispel Magic for bomb removal; Reactive Barrier for damage after a qualifying catch.

best.note: A readable bomb burst keeps forcing you out of lane.
methods: Barrier before the explosion and leave its damage area. It does not prevent Soul Exchange.
Alternative: Spirit Shielding for repeated spell sequences; cast denial for the swap.

best.note: A telegraphed charged shot costs you farm or forces a recall.
methods: Use cover first; activate before an unavoidable shot rather than after it lands.
Alternative: Spirit Shielding for repeated spirit bursts; Rusted Barrel for lane gun pressure.

best.note: A visible missile or landing burst forces you out of lane.
methods: Activate before damage and leave the follow-up angle. It does not prevent a landing stun or grab.
Alternative: Spirit Shielding for spell follow-up; Reactive Barrier for qualifying catches.

best.note: A telegraphed Power Slash cannot be avoided safely.
methods: Use cover first; time the barrier for the slash rather than its windup.
Alternative: Spirit Shielding for sustained spell pressure; it does not answer her ultimate.

best.note: A visible dive creates one predictable damage window.
methods: Activate before the landing, then move out of follow-up range.
Alternative: Spirit Shielding for repeated spell damage; Ethereal Shift for a larger committed burst.

alts.text: Reactive Barrier (1,600) gives automatic protection after qualifying control, including silence. It does not remove the control.
Spirit Shielding (1,600) gives an automatic barrier after concentrated spirit damage and adds spirit resist.
Weapon Shielding (1,600) gives an automatic barrier after concentrated weapon damage and adds bullet resist.
Guardian Ward (1,600) adds speed and can protect an ally, at half cooldown on allies.

guardian-ward.name: Заслон стража
guardian-ward.short: Barrier and speed for you or an ally; half cooldown on allies.
guardian-ward.intro: Catches and dives where a teammate needs a barrier and room to escape.
guardian-ward.who: Support players and teammates with a safe angle to protect the threatened player, or heroes needing a manual self-protection window.
guardian-ward.when: Barrier before the main damage; use speed to reach cover when movement is available. The ally-cast cooldown is halved.
guardian-ward.watch: No cleanse, control immunity, pull or channel interruption. Speed does not free a stunned or immobilized target. The ally must be targetable and within usable cast range.
guardian-ward.buy: Upgrade Grit when ally protection or movement changes the next fight. The sample supports all stages, most often mid game. A late purchase remains possible, but compare a stronger save when a small barrier no longer suffices.
why: Barrier plus movement speed on yourself or a teammate
No cleanse, pull or control immunity

best.note: A hooked ally needs protection against bomb and uppercut follow-up.
methods: Cast from safety before the main damage; it does not clear Sticky Bomb.
Alternative: Divine Barrier for eligible debuff removal; Rescue Beam for repositioning.

best.note: A caught ally survives the charge but dies to punches afterward.
methods: Barrier the ally before follow-up; speed helps once movement is available.
Alternative: Reactive Barrier for automatic self-protection; Rebuttal or movement for the engage.

best.note: Her entry burst threatens your carry before teammates can respond.
methods: Barrier before the burst; movement helps create a safer follow-up angle.
Alternative: Spirit defense for repeated burst; Slowing Hex for the escape.

best.note: A teammate is about to take a visible dive burst.
methods: Shield before the landing and help them move away from follow-up.
Alternative: Spirit protection or a timed invulnerability response for larger burst.

best.note: A landing or marked-target burst exposes a teammate.
methods: Shield before the damage and help the eventual reposition; it does not remove a mark or break a grab.
Alternative: Spirit Shielding or Reactive Barrier for self-defense; anti-air for his angle.

best.note: A low-health ally is exposed to aerial gunfire or a finishing shot.
methods: Shield before damage and move them toward cover; it does not ground Vindicta.
Alternative: Knockdown for the aerial threat; appropriate damage defense for repeated pressure.

alts.text: Divine Barrier (6,400) gives a larger barrier and removes eligible non-stun debuffs.
Rescue Beam (3,200) heals and pulls an ally, fixing their position, which a barrier alone cannot do.
Grit (800) is the component: a cheap self-only barrier you time before a readable hit.
Reactive Barrier (1,600) protects only you, but triggers automatically after qualifying control.
